tr_h_list: When a user enters a command, the system shall execute it through the Bash shell.
When a user enters an invalid command, the system shall display an error message.
When a user enters a command with insufficient privileges, the system shall deny execution.
When a file containing commands is provided, the system shall execute them.
When an empty file is provided, the system shall not execute any commands.
When a non-existent file is provided, the system shall display an error message.
When multiple processes are running, the system shall allow job control.
When only one process is running, the system shall not allow job control.
When a user attempts to access a non-existent GNU utility, the system shall display an error message.
When a single quote occurs between single quotes, the system shall report an error.
When a non-zero exit status occurs, the system shall terminate with an error code.
When job control is not active, the system shall not attempt to use job control features.
When EXPR2 evaluates to zero, the system shall not perform the associated action.
When no PATTERN matches, the system shall report an error or take alternative action.
When EOF is read, the system shall handle end-of-file condition correctly.
When unescaped double quote characters result in empty strings, the system shall report an error.
When a regular expression is syntactically incorrect, the system shall report an error.
When a syntax error occurs or a readonly function with the same name already exists, the system shall report an error.
When maximum function nesting level is exceeded, the system shall report an error.
When User executes a command, the Shell shall provide command history expansion facilities.
When Translator translates a string, the gettext tools shall produce an MO file.
When single quote may not occur between single quotes, the Shell shall raise an error.
When non-zero exit status occurs, the Bash shall display an error message.
When job control is not active, the Shell shall disable job control features.
When EXPR2 evaluates to zero, the Shell shall raise an error.
When no PATTERN matches, the Shell shall display a warning message.
When EOF is read, the Shell shall exit.
When unescaped double quote characters result in empty strings, the Shell shall raise an error.
When regular expression is syntactically incorrect, the Shell shall raise an error.
The Shell shall preserve the literal value of the next character when a backslash is encountered.
The Translator shall copy the template file to a separate file for each target language.
When a user enables 'Metafy next character typed', the system shall display the metafied character.
When a user performs tilde expansion on current word, the system shall expand the tilde to the user's home directory.
When a user installs compiled translations, the system shall make the translations available for use.
When a user calls the waitpid function, the system shall return the process ID of the child process.
When a user requests the exit status of the last command executed, the system shall return the exit status.
When a user sets the value of NAME to selected word, the system shall store the selected word as the value of NAME.
When a user evaluates a conditional expression EXPRESSION, the system shall return the result of the evaluation.
When a user defines a shell function named FNAME, the system shall store the function definition.
The system shall provide a clear and concise structure to facilitate easier verification of implementation within 1 minute.
The system shall enable technology transfer by providing accessible documentation and resources within 1 hour.
